concepts.title: Moonlit Court: Masked Player vs. Skeleton
Shadow Arena: Hooded Skeleton vs. Werewolf

visualReview: Both finished concepts were visually inspected. They use flat ink outlines and printed comic textures, changed horror characters, simplified backgrounds, and no hotel buildings, hospitality robots, drones, or gifts. The gameplay court, two opposing players, one volleyball, and a central edge-on pole remain visible.
